correctness.rationale: PBH for real symmetric Laplacians reduces rank loss to eigenvectors with zero controlled coordinate. The two-arc sine recurrence proves all non-0,non-4 dark eigenvectors must be the cycle sine modes satisfying n|2kd, counted exactly as floor((gcd(n,2d)-1)/2); its q≠0 branch is contradicted by the boundary identities for every w>0. The λ=4 linear-limit recurrence forces both even arc lengths and precisely w=1/d+1/(n-d), and constructs a one-dimensional extra eigenspace. Connectedness eliminates λ=0. A standalone standard-library checker reproduced 2645 finite-field lower-bound Krylov ranks (n=4..48) and exact rational λ=4 eigenvectors. Experiments do not replace the all-size proof.

Direct full-text study of the 2011 cycle controllability paper and the 2014 theta spectral paper found neither this rank law nor its exceptional positive-weight mode. value.rationale: The exact rank of a physically natural single-driver consensus network is determined for every cycle size, chord position and positive weight. It reveals an arithmetical family of persistently unreachable harmonics and an isolated positive conductance where controllability decreases by one, despite a fixed graph topology. This gives a complete natural classification rather than a small numerical example, and identifies a resonance relevant to topology/weight design. The critical weight is precisely the reciprocal of the original-cycle effective resistance between chord endpoints, giving the resonance a natural electrical interpretation.
